_doc: fc-parallel-007 (web): 2x http_get + 1x http_post; depends_on_order: true. The post is a summary of the two gets, so the model has to fetch before posting. Tests mixed-tool parallel calls with a real data dependency. Decoys: web_search (wrong medium). ORDER CONTRACT (M1, PR #31): same as fc-parallel-006 — strict positional is kept because order-insensitive would wrongly pass post-before-get (the post body depends on the gets). The prompt pins the gets' literal order ('First fetch A and B, then POST'); the model is expected to follow it. A future depends_on_order: 'partial' knob in #19 would let the two gets be mutually unordered.
prompt: First fetch the order details from https://api.example.com/orders/42 and the customer profile from https://api.example.com/customers/alice, then POST a summary {"customer": "alice", "order": 42} to https://api.example.com/summarize.

function.name: http_get
function.description: Issue an HTTP GET request to the given absolute URL and return the response body as a string. The optional `headers` field is a JSON object of header name to value. Follows up to 5 redirects.

function.name: http_post
function.description: Issue an HTTP POST request to the given absolute URL with a JSON body. Returns the response body as a string.
